simulation.notes: JS_266 with the WebSUMO browser viewer: the standard distributed-mode run (simengine.py + clockwork over NATS) plus the websumo block below, which streams the simulation to a WebSUMO viewer and serves it the network file. Run: simengine.py --conf models/JS_266_DEMO/sim/JS_266_sim_websumo.json  (clockwork with its normal JS_266 conf). See doc/websumo_integration_plan.md.

det_outputs.notes: Detector occupancy to the control engine (clockwork subscribes per its conf channels)

sig_outputs.notes: SUMO-side group status not needed for the OC control loop
